meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: Claude 会用 Azure 命令查询订阅的配额(资源上限)与当前用量,输出各区域剩余可用量;也能列出全部配额、对比区域、申请提高配额。
howto.when: 当你说出“查配额”、“当前使用量”、“申请提高配额”等关键词,或询问某个区域还能部署多少资源时触发。

say.text: 查一下 eastus 区域的计算配额和当前用量
say.note: 运行配额检查脚本,返回限制、用量与可用量。

say.text: 对比 eastus 和 westus2 的虚拟机配额剩余
say.note: 对两个区域分别查询并比较可用容量。

howto.what_en: Claude uses Azure CLI to check quotas and current usage, report available capacity per region, list all quotas, compare regions, and submit increase requests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to check quotas or current usage, request a quota increase, or ask how many resources can be deployed in a region.

say_en.text: Check compute quota and current usage for eastus.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage, and available capacity.

say_en.text: Compare remaining VM quota between eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Queries both regions and compares available capacity.

say_en.text: Raise the standardDSv3Family quota to 500 in eastus.
say_en.note: Submits an increase request and returns approval status.
